info.description: GraphQL API test suite for ProLife's own domain surface (Accounts, Orders, Sensors/Devices, Licenses/SoftwareProducts, Workspace dashboards, DeviceCollectionDocumentService). One request/test per GraphQL field (43 fields total), built by analogy with Puma's TenantApiPostman and ProLife's own DeskTicketApiPostman. Shared imtauth fields (Authorization, CreateSuperuser) are used only as bootstrap infrastructure, not separately tested here. Shared imtapp GetApplicationInfo is checked only for ProLife's tenantsEnabled configuration. IotDevice fields (IotDeviceAdd/Update/List/Item and the IotDevice document-service operations) were removed - they aren't part of ProLife's own Sensors devices and had no real coverage story here (new/exploratory, all failing on real server validation errors unrelated to the collection itself).
